niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, contemporary interfaces with clear hierarchy, restrained chrome, and either airy editorial minimalism or moody premium drama when it feels intentional. Consistently favors strong structure, coherent grouping, visible completeness, and calm visual control over generic utility screens or cluttered modular layouts. Likes soft rounded forms, integrated search and controls, concise but warm copy, and imagery that creates atmosphere without feeling noisy.

criteria.description: More open spacing, calmer vertical rhythm, and less crowded stacking.
Strong, readable hierarchy through scale, spacing, and orderly top-down structure.
Calm, polished, editorial minimalism with minimal ornamentation and less interface furniture.
Subtle low-contrast cards, softer boundaries, and gentler tonal transitions rather than harsh separation.
Content organized into clear, tidy modules or sections with clean separation and logical chunking.
Prominent, well-scaled typography with clear section labels and confident headline hierarchy.
Warmer, more natural microcopy that feels human rather than system-like or procedural.
Softer rounded cards, controls, and contours that create a gentler, more refined feel.
Search bars and controls that blend smoothly into the page with softer fills and less visual interruption.
Screens that feel populated, balanced, and fully resolved rather than sparse, empty, or unfinished.
